messages:
maria: Kickoff for the external assessment next week. Need to lock scope (RBAC delta changes, KMS access, audit export retention) and owners. Who can take RBAC?
ajay: I can take RBAC changes. Can you list exact namespaces/resources the assessor needs?
sophie: Assessor should be read-only for namespaces: infra, platform, and readonly access to secrets listing (no secret values). They also need read access to audit logs in the SIEM. No write permitted.
kevin: For KMS, we prefer granting a scoped decrypt-only grant rather than giving raw key access. Propose creating a short-lived grant tied to an assessor service principal.
ajay: Rough IAM snippet for scoped KMS decrypt (we'll refine):
```
- Effect: Allow
  Action:
    - kms:Decrypt
  Resource: arn:aws:kms:us-west-2:123456789:key/abcd-1234
  Condition:
    StringEquals:
      kms:CallerAccount: "123456789"
```

sophie: Important: we need audit proof for every KMS call. Ops, can we export CloudTrail to a read-only bucket and give presigned access for the assessment window?
ops-bot: export-trail job queued -> s3://redwood-assessment-logs-2026 (ETA 2026-03-14T09:00Z). Will tag objects with assessor-window metadata. :white_check_mark:
kevin: Also add a SIEM sample query so assessors can spot check KMS activity, e.g. `index=cloudtrail eventName=Decrypt` and `resource=kms/key/abcd-1234`.
maria: Remediation tracking plan: we'll use the ENG-SEC board `Assessment-2026Q1` (epics + tickets for each vuln). Please assign yourself on PRs and remediation cards. Retest windows: propose Fri 2026-03-19 or Mon 2026-03-22. Preference?
ajay: Fri 03/19 works for infra; we can freeze non-essential deploys that day.
sophie: I'm oncall Mon 03/22 but can cover Fri 03/19 as well. :thumbsup:
maria: To minimize blast radius, create RBAC changes as a PR with a TTL label and an automated revert job that runs after 7 days. Devops — can you add a revoke job or TTL controller?
devops: Will add a cronjob that removes the assessor role after 7d and records the revert in the audit bucket. I'll put up a PR: https://github.com/redwood/platform-infra/pull/912
maria: Nice. Also: if KMS grant isn't possible due to policy constraints, fallback will be vetted key-wrapped exports (limited dataset) we pre-generate and upload to the read-only bucket. Kevin, Sophie — agree?
kevin: Agreed. We'll prepare a deterministic export and include HMAC proofs.
sophie: Agreed. tagging @oncall for final approval on the schedule and TTL approach.
oncall: Approved for Fri 2026-03-19 pending PR merge and audit export availability. :white_check_mark: 
maria: Thanks everyone. I'll draft the assessor checklist (access list, SIEM queries, sample logs, allowed actions) and drop in #eng-security this afternoon. Keep updates in this thread and link remediation tickets to the board.
